note: Reason categories for the compliance flag on every v0.2 screen, and what the compliance reviewers are asked to check for each. Screens with no user-facing copy carry review false with the reason internal; user-facing screens with no regulated content carry review false with the reason plain copy.

advertising code.check: Projections and the two paths, the sample plan, testimonials, any returns language, comparisons.

advice language.check: How advice is worded, suitability and risk band references, consider versus must, verify actions versus diagnoses.

disclosures.check: The RIA registration line, the fee schedule, the complaints and grievance path, what the app is and is not, what a call is and is not.

fees and refunds.check: Inclusive of GST, the period, cancellation, refund, breakage.

consent.check: AA consent wording and period, the DPDP notice, CAS password handling, the declaration, deletion.

execution.check: Order and mandate language, direct plan, rail disclosures.

internal.check: No user-facing copy; nothing to review.

plain copy.check: No regulated content identified. Comment on language if anything reads as advice or a promise.
